items.quote: Receivable days are a little high nowadays because final bills are still pending in our three projects like NBCC Aligarh project and Telecomnunications India Limited, two projects we have completed, but the funds are - final bill and final approval, all things are pending

items.statement: Company has not availed mobilization advance for new projects including IIT and Bathinda despite 10% clause being available, preferring to use internal funds.
items.quote: We have just received a project IIT [inaudible 0:23:37]. We can take mobilization advance, but we have not availed the mobilization advance till now. It is an interest-bearing advance.

items.statement: Expecting much better positive operating cash flow by H1 FY27 as current assets convert to cash
items.quote: Of course, by the H1, we are expecting the much better positive cash flow from operations.

items.statement: Working capital increased by INR 180 crores in Q1 FY27 driven by inventory cost inflation and safety stock build-up; receivables aging remains well controlled
items.quote: So you're right that our working capital has gone up during this crisis period. However, this is largely driven by inventories.

items.statement: Receivables value grew due to pricing but underlying aging and quality remain solid and well controlled
items.quote: That is right. So while the value would grow because we have taken pricing, the number of days and the aging is well under control.

items.statement: Operating cash profit was about 12-12.5 crores in Q1 FY27; working capital increased due to high copper prices and capex of 4.2 crores was incurred.
items.quote: The operating cash profit was fairly healthy for the Q1, I'd say about 12-12 and a half crores, but of course, working capital has also gone up.

items.statement: Pet food project land purchase of INR 25 crores completed; total estimated investment INR 175 crores
items.quote: We are estimating around INR 175 crores investment in a pet food. Till now, we have purchased land around INR 25 crores worth of land.

items.statement: Management expects positive cash flow this fiscal year after negative cash flow last year due to inventory buildup for new retail store
items.quote: Yes, definitely, this year, we will be having a good cash -- positive cash flow because we have what they say, correct fund plans with regards to how we are going to operate with for the -- fulfill the stock requirement of the upcoming stores.

items.statement: Raised INR52.93 crores through rights issue for working capital and general corporate purposes
items.quote: During Q1, we raised INR52.93 crores through the rights issue. This provides additional resource for working capital and general corporate purpose, and give us greater flexibility to support our expansion plan and customers' requirement.

items.statement: Company is almost debt-free and intends to fund expansion plans including Sampla facility, Frank Metals aluminium extrusion investment and LFP plant largely through internal accruals rather than external borrowings.
items.quote: We are almost debt-free company at our core and we intend to fund our ongoing expansion plans including the Sa mpla facility, Frank Metal s aluminum extrusion investment and the upcoming LFP plant largely through internal accruals other than relying on external borrowings.
